name: Parque Patagonia: Lagunas Altas
region: Patagonia National Park, Valle Chacabuco sector, Aysén
why: A loop above the Chacabuco valley: up from the campground to a plateau of small lakes, then a long balcony over the steppe where guanacos graze, down to the park headquarters.
book: Register with the Valle Chacabuco administration; entry and campsites through Pases Parques (pasesparques.cl). The trail is closed June to September. Turn off the Carretera Austral 17 km north of Cochrane, then drive 11 km east.
water: Streams and lakes on the plateau (treat them); none on the descent: carry 2 litres.
dangers: Pumas and feral dogs live in the park (CONAF): stay in a group and keep children close.
Strong wind and sudden cold on the open plateau.
Snow on the high part in spring: ask the rangers about trail conditions.
turnaround: Not at the high lakes by 13:00: go back down the way you came rather than on to the longer descent.

points.name: West Winds campground
points.note: The park campground in the Chacabuco valley; the trail climbs south from its upper end into lenga woods.

points.name: Laguna Norita
points.note: First of the high lakes on the plateau, after the steady climb out of the forest.

points.name: Lagunas Altas viewpoint
points.note: Above Laguna Meche, with the Chacabuco valley, the steppe and the Andes of Aysén around you.

points.name: Descent to park headquarters
points.note: The trail ends by the park headquarters and lodge; follow the valley path or road back to West Winds.
